63: So they have ten events?\n...Which Pokémon should I choose?
64: There are five Pokéathlon courses!\rThey are divided into Speed, Power,\nStamina, Jump, and Skill.\rYou have to choose your Pokémon\ncarefully according to the course.
65: Some Pokémon are good at Speed events.\nSome are not. You need to form a team\fwhose members can help one another.
66: If you go on, you’ll see the\nMuseum of Pokéathlete Records.\rI will someday be a Pokéathlete holding\na record there!
67: The score you achieve in the Pokéathlon\nwill become Athlete Points, and you can\fexchange them for prizes.\rYou may be the last team to finish, but\nyour score will still count!
68: “Hurdle Dash”\rMany Hurdles await your Pokémon!\nBe faster and more precise than\feveryone else! Jump over the Hurdles\fand aim for number one!
69: “Pennant Capture”\rPennants are hidden on the beach.\nFight over them and come back with as\fmany Pennants as you can!
70: “Circle Push”\rThe time has come to show off your\nPokémon’s Power!\fPush them away and stay in the Circle!
71: “Block Smash”\rA mountain of Blocks awaits\nyour Pokémon!\fUse its Power to smash them all!
72: “Disc Catch”\rDiscs are thrown at you. Jump and\ncatch them in the air!\rDon’t get cornered by others.\nCatch as many as you can!
73: “Lamp Jump”\rYou never know how high you’re going\nto bounce! Use your Pokémon’s Jump\fand Skill to score!
74: “Relay Run”\rKeep running until you can’t run\nany more! Three Pokémon work together\fto achieve victory!
75: “Ring Drop”\rPokémon tackle! Go beyond your Stamina\nlimit and stay in the Ring!
76: “Snow Throw”\rOn an incredibly cold playfield,\nmillions of balls of Snow await!\rAim and throw!\nTime it right to show your skill!
77: “Goal Roll”\rPut your heart into hitting the ball!\nAttack! Defend your Goal!\rAim for the other Goals!\nWho gets the victory?
78: Work with your Pokémon. Believe in them,\nand help them believe in you! Believe in\ftheir potential. Let the friendship lead\fyour team to victory!\rThe Pokéathlon is always with you!
79: Charge your energy with friendship!\nGive Aprijuice to your Pokémon!
